detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:
Follistatin 344 — Derived Synthetic Peptide Fragment

Chemical Information:

  • Compound Type: Synthetic peptide fragment
  • Reference Designation: Follistatin 344 (parent protein context)
  • Molecular Weight: Refer to lot-specific CoA
  • Form: Supplied as a lyophilized powder for laboratory use
Molecular Structure:
Not applicable; refer to lot-specific CoA for structural characterization.
Product Description:
Follistatin 344 — Synthetic Fragment is a chemically synthesized 50-amino-acid derived fragment, supplied as a research-grade reference material for in vitro analytical and laboratory research applications. The compound is prepared by solid-phase peptide synthesis (SPPS) and supplied as a lyophilized powder. Refer to the lot-specific Certificate of Analysis for chemical characterization, including identity, sequence range, molecular weight, and analytical purity.

Research Applications:

  • In vitro analytical reference applications in laboratory research settings
  • Comparative evaluation across controlled experimental conditions
  • Analytical method development and characterization

Storage and Handling:

  • Store lyophilized powder at −20 °C until use
  • Reconstitute only in validated laboratory assay buffers by qualified research personnel
  • Not sterile; not for injection or administration
  • After reconstitution, store at −80 °C in single-use aliquots
  • Avoid repeated freeze–thaw cycles
  • Maintain aseptic laboratory technique during handling

Product Specifications:

  • Purity: Refer to lot-specific CoA
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white to off-white powder
  • Solubility: Refer to lot-specific CoA. For in vitro assay preparation only.
Compliance Notice:
Follistatin 344 — Synthetic Fragment is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
